Effect.never is returned only by generateText during the test, not executed during layer acquisition. Retain deterministic TestClock for the two timeout subjects and do not unconditionally exclude test services.
No resource change required: LangExtractError/VerifiedSpanError equivalence is pure schema computation, with no remote model or persistence.
